source: 746 Corpse Wax Candle
target: 746 Candela Cerae Cadaveris

source: 746 Corpse Wax Candle
target: 746 Candela Cerae Cadaveris

source: A mystical item made from an Iron-blooded Knight Beyonder characteristic?
target: Res arcana ex attributo Beyonder equitis sanguine ferrei confecta?

source: The Law of Beyonder Characteristics Convergence sure is handy…
target: Lex coniunctionis proprietatum Beyonder certe utilis est…

source: A Fate Appropriator’s sensitivity to fate must have contributed a bit…
target: Sensitivitas Fatoris Appropriatoris ad fatum paulum contulit…

source: Or, could it be the result of some arrangement?
target: An id ex aliqua ordinatione evenit?

source: Lumian was first surprised, then felt the aftereffects of a traumatic bestowment.
target: Lumian primum obstupuit, deinde vestigia effectuum traumatici doni sensit.

source: Madam Magician seemed to sense his thoughts and chuckled, saying, “I don’t know if this is a bestowment from fate, but even if it is, it’s the kind we were hoping for and can certainly accept.”
target: Domina Magica cogitationes eius quasi sentiebat et subridens dixit: “Nescio utrum hoc sit donum a fato, sed etsi ita sit, genus est quod sperabamus et certe accipere possumus.”

source: Lumian silently nodded.
target: Lumian silentio annuit.

source: Mr. Hanged Man, speaking calmly, said, “Don’t overcomplicate your thoughts, just consider two things:”
target: Vir suspenditus, tranquille loquens, dixit: “Nolite cogitationes vestras nimis complicare, sed duo tantum considera:”

source: First, you now have no ability to escape this arrangement.
target: Primum, nunc nullam habes facultatem hujus ordinationis effugiendi.

source: Sometimes, what you think of as resistance or rebellion might actually be a predetermined part of the process, and Mr. Fool’s Angels aren’t always available to protect you.
target: Interdum, id quod existimas esse resistentiam vel seditionem, re vera pars praedestinata processus esse potest, et Angeli Domini Stulti non sunt semper praesto ut te protegeant.

source: Remember, accepting reality isn’t a sign of weakness; finding opportunities within such realities is a true act of courage.
target: Memento, realitatem accipere non est signum infirmitatis; sed in talibus realitatibus occasiones invenire verum est actus fortitudinis.

source: Second, maximize the benefits that this bestowment of fate brings.
target: Secundo, beneficia huius fati doni ad maximum auge.

source: Work hard to improve yourself.
target: Strenue labora ut te meliorem facias.

source: This doesn’t mean giving up but rather tests your wisdom and determination.
target: Hoc non significat renuntiationem, sed potius probat sapientiam et constantiam tuam.

source: When you sense danger or anything unusual, remember, we will always stand by you.
target: Cum periculum aut aliquid insolitum sentis, memento, nos semper ad te erimus.

source: Remember, Mr. Fool can interfere with those plans, but as you know, He isn’t fully awake and can’t frequently provide protection—only at critical moments.
target: Memento, Dominus Stultus illis consiliis immixere potest, sed ut scis, non est omnino vigil et non plerumque tutelam praebet—tantum in momentis criticis.

source: After listening intently, Lumian slowly nodded, finding a different kind of resonance and persuasiveness in hearing these ideas voiced by someone else.
target: Postquam attente auscultavit, Lumian lente annuit, inveniens aliam speculationem resonantiae et persuasivitatis ex his ideis a alio proferendis.

source: Mr. Hanged Man thought for a moment, then added, “What you need to be most wary of is the attempt to resurrect the Blood Emperor through you.
target: Vir suspenditus paulisper cogitavit, deinde addidit: “Quod maxime cavendum est, est conatus per te resurrectionis Imperatoris Sanguinis.

source: You must be extra cautious in similar situations going forward.
target: Extra cautus esse debes in futuris similibus condicionibus.

source: “I’ll remember that, thank you, Mr. Hanged Man,” Lumian replied sincerely.
target: “Illud meminero, gratias tibi, Domine Suspenditus,” respondit Lumian sincere.

source: Madam Magician then steered the conversation back on track.
target: Domina Magica deinde sermonem ad rectam viam rediit.

source: “You can take out the items you’ve gathered, and I’ll help you evaluate their powers and any negative effects.”
target: “Potes res quas congregavisti extrahere, et ego te adiuvabo ut earum virtutes et incommoda effectus aestimes.”

source: With the promise of support, Lumian reached into the Traveler’s Bag and grasped the hilt of the dark, iron-black broadsword.
target: Cum promissione sustinendi, Lumian in sacculum Viatoris incursavit et manubrium gladii latis, nigri ferri apprehendit.

source: Suddenly, his inner worries, like clouds in the sky, were scattered by a terrifying wind, vanishing in an instant.
target: Subito, internae sollicitudines eius, ut nubes in caelo, vento terribili disperguntur atque in momento evanescunt.

source: Why fear a bestowment from fate?
target: Cur donum a fato timendum est?

source: Why fear the arrangements of the gods?
target: Cur deorum ordinationes timere?

source: To hell with them all!
target: Ad inferos omnes!

source: May they all go to hell!
target: Ut omnes in inferos descendant!

source: In that moment, Lumian was filled with courage, feeling as though he could swing his broadsword at the True Creator Himself if He appeared before him right then.
target: Illo momento, Lumian virtute repletus est, sentiens se posse gladium latus in ipso Verissimo Creatore impellere, si ille statim appareret.

source: He drew the black broadsword, its flames extinguished yet still radiating intense heat, and handed it to Madam Magician.
target: Gladium nigrum extraxit, cujus flammae exstinctae, sed adhuc ardorem singularem efferentes, illud Dominae Magicae tradidit.

source: Madam Magician looked at him, took the sword, and joked, “How about we call it the ‘Sword of Courage’?”
target: Domina Magica eum conspexit, gladium accepit, et iocose dixit: “Quomodo id vocemus Gladium Fortitudinis?”

source: “The Sword of Courage…” Lumian paused for a moment.
target: “Gladium Fortitudinis…” Lumian paulisper haesitavit.

source: As the black broadsword left his grasp and was taken by Madam Magician, he shivered violently.
target: Cum gladium nigrum e manu eius deflueret et Domina Magica reportaret, vehementer trepidavit.

source: What was I thinking?
target: Quid putabam?

source: I nearly blasphemed His sacred name…
target: Paene nomen sacrum eius blasphemai…

source: How could I believe I was capable of deicide?
target: Quomodo credere poteram me deicidem esse posse?

source: In a moment of fright, Lumian’s eyes returned to the black broadsword in Madam Magician’s hands.
target: In momento terroris, oculi Lumiani ad gladium nigrum in manibus Dominae Magicae redeunti sunt.

source: Could it be its negative influence?
target: Num eius influentia negativa sit?

source: Could it really inspire the courage to commit deicide?
target: Num vere fortitudinem ad deicidium committendum inspirare possit?

source: Stars sparkled in Madam Magician’s eyes as she gazed at the sword and explained,
target: Stellae in oculis Dominae Magicae fulgebant, dum gladium intuēbatur et explicabat,

source: “This sword fills its bearer with courage, ensuring they are not knocked down by fear or paralyzed by fright.”
target: “Hic gladius portatorem suum fortitudine replet, curans ut non metu deiectus aut terrore immobilis fiat.”

source: If you had held this sword earlier, even if you were ultimately ‘conquered, you could have endured a bit longer.
target: Si hoc gladium antea tenuisses, etsi tandem superatus esses, aliquantulum diutius tolerare potuisses.

source: “It’s extremely durable and sharp, capable of blocking direct attacks from demigods and significantly impacting their defenses.
target: “Hic gladius valde durabilis ac acutus est, et aptus est ictus directos a semideis obstruere et defensionibus eorum graviter impingere.”

source: It can also enable you to perform Cull at the level of an Iron-blooded Knight, but this will consume a great deal of your spirituality, roughly two-thirds of it in one go.
target: “Quod etiam te facit ‘Cull’ peragere in gradu equitis sanguinis ferrei, sed hoc ingentem tuam spiritualitatem consumet, circiter duas partes trium simul.”

source: The sword can also absorb half of the damage for you.
target: Gladius etiam dimidium damni pro te absorbere potest.

source: That is, even if you fail to block an attack and suffer a fatal wound, it can reduce the severity of that wound from fatal to grave.
target: Id est, etiam si ictum impediere non potes et vulneri letali subis, potest severitatem vulneris, ab letali ad grave, minuere.

source: Each strike carries high-temperature flames, and depending on your will, these flames can spread from your weapon to your enemy’s body upon contact, and each strike can cause massive explosion.
target: Unusquisque ictus flammas altae temperiae fert, et secundum voluntatem tuam, hae flammas ab armamento tuo ad corpus hostis in contactu diffundi possunt, et quisque ictus magnam explosionem causare potest.

source: If the sword is coated with your target’s blood or if they’ve been scorched by its flames, you can throw it up to five kilometers into the sky.
target: Si gladius sanguine propositi tinctus est aut si eius flammae eos combussere, eum ad quinque chiliometra in caelum iaculari potes.

source: It will wrap itself in flames, fly toward the target like a live artillery shell, lock on, and then crash down, creating a violent explosion that can destroy everything in a typical public square.
target: Ipse se in flammas involvet, ad propositum instar globuli tormentarii vivorum volabit, se figet, deinde ruet, creans violentam explosionem quae omnia in foro publico destruere potest.

source: The maximum range is five kilometers, and it won’t return to you on its own; you’ll need to retrieve it.
target: Distantia maxima est quinque chiliometra, et non se ipso ad te retribuet; te ipsi eum recuperare oportet.

source: There are two drawbacks.
target: Duae sunt incommoditates.

source: First, excessive courage is a lethal poison.
target: Primum, nimia fortitudo est venenum letale. fear and apprehension are among the key reasons humans have survived to this era.

source: A person who only knows courage and not fear will likely lose their ability to judge and analyze, leading to a swift demise.
target: Qui solam fortitudinem novit et timorem ignorat, probabiliter facultatem iudicandi et analyzandi amittet, quod celerem exitium adducet.

source: Second, it needs companions.
target: Secundo, adiutores necesse sunt.

source: You’ll need to prepare at least thirty ordinary broadswords to place around it to complete the sealing process.
target: Tibi necesse erit saltem triginta gladios ordinaris parare, quos circa eum disponere debes ad sigillum perficiendum.

source: Otherwise, within about fifteen minutes, it will start attacking everyone nearby indiscriminately, including you.
target: Alioquin, intra circiter quindecim minuta, omnes in vicinitate sine discrimine, te etiam includens, oppugnare incipiet.

source: Don’t think about using the residual aura of the Blood Emperor to avoid or deter this, as this sword doesn’t have living characteristics; it’s a manifestation of its destructive godhood.
target: Noli cogitare de usu aurae residualis Imperatoris Sanguinis ad hoc vitandum aut deterrendum, quoniam hic gladius proprietates viventis non habet; manifestatio enim est eius destructivae deitatis.

source: It also constantly emits high temperatures, causing ordinary broadswords around it to gradually melt.
target: Insuper constanter altam temperiem emittit, quae gladios ordinarios circa eum paulatim liquescere faciunt.

source: So, you’ll need to regularly replace its companions.
target: Ita necesse est ut adiutores eius regulariter reponas.

source: Similarly, for you as the Reaper, it means enduring a progressively intensifying burn injury.
target: Similiter, tibi ut Messor, hoc significat tolerare vulnera ustionis paulatim intensificanda.

source: That’s about it.
target: Hoc est.

source: If you don’t mind, we can call it the ‘Sword of Courage’.
target: Si non molestum est, id “Gladium Fortitudinis” appellare possumus.

source: Lumian nodded and replied, “Can the negative effects of being filled with courage be avoided if it’s carried in the Traveler’s Bag?”
target: Lumian annuit et respondit: “Num effectus negativos virtute repleti vitari possunt, si in Sacculo Viatoris feruntur?”

source: “Yes,” Madam Magician nodded gently.
target: “Ita,” leniter annuit Domina Magica.

source: Lumian pondered further and asked, “In the room where I found this sword, there was only one piece of armor, an altar, and two other items.
target: Lumian ulterius cogitavit et rogavit: “In camera qua hunc gladium inveni, sola fuit una armatura, altare, et duo alia supellectiles.

source: Why didn’t it destroy those things?”
target: Cur ea non deleverit?

source: “That suit of armor is its companion,” Madam Magician replied promptly.
target: “Illa armatura comes eius est,” respondit Domina Magica statim.

source: Lumian did not inquire further and began to consider how to use the Sword of Courage: / must fully assess the situation and make the right judgment before drawing the sword…
target: Lumian ulterius non quaesivit et cogitare coepit quomodo Gladium Fortitudinis uti debeat: rem plenissime aestimare atque iudicium rectum ferre ante gladium trahendum…

source: This isn’t a commander’s scepter; it’s a bugle for the charge…
target: Hoc non est sceptrum imperatoris; est buccina ad impetum…

source: /ts use must not exceed fifteen minutes…
target: “/ts” usus non debet quindecim minuta excedere…

source: While thinking, Lumian reached out and took hold of the Sword of Courage.
target: Dum cogitabat, Lumian manum extendit et Gladium Fortitudinis apprehendit.

source: In the next second, he felt he didn’t need to overthink: Fear of this, fear of that—all of that only leads to failure!
target: In secundo proximo sensit se non opus esse nimis cogitare: timor huius, timor illius—haec omnia ad defectum tantum ducunt!

source: One should not be overly cautious or indecisive, just do it!
target: Non nimis cautus aut irresolutus esse debet, solum age!

source: What is there to fear?
target: Quid est timendum?

source: Madam Magician reached into the void and, from nowhere, produced dozens of broadswords with slight variations in design, letting them fly towards Lumian.
target: Domina Magica in vacuum manum porriguit et, ex nihilo, complura gladios laterales cum levibus variationibus in forma protulit, eosque ad Lumian volitare permisit.

source: After placing the Sword of Courage among these broadswords and stuffing it back into the Traveler’s Bag, Lumian snapped back to his senses.
target: Postquam Gladium Fortitudinis inter hos gladios posuit et in Sacculum Viatoris recludit, Lumian ad sui sensus rediit.

source: He couldn’t help but silently scoff at himself.
target: Non potuit quin se tacite irridens reprehenderet.

source: An Ascetic’s abilities don’t work in this case…
target: Virtutes asceticorum in hoc casu non operandum esse videntur…

source: Then, he took out a piece of pristine, fine leather and a half-solid, pale yellowish-red candle housed in a transparent glass vial.
target: Deinde, extraxit partem corii pristini et candelam semi-solidam, pallide luteo‐rubram, in vitro vitreo perspicuo receptam.

source: Stars again twinkled in Madam Magician’s eyes as she took the two items and examined them for several seconds.
target: Stellae iterum in oculis Dominae Magicae micabant, dum has duas res arripiebat et per aliquot secundos examinabat.

source: “This is indeed the potion formula of the Demoness of Despair, but the human skin carrying it comes from an ancient Demoness of Despair and contains strong, mystically powerful viruses, bacteria, and fungi.
target: “Haec vere est formula poculi Demonissae Desperationis, sed corium humanum quod eam gerit ex antiqua Demonissa Desperationis provenit et potentissimis, mystice validis virus, bacterias, et fungi continet.

source: It causes those who touch or gaze upon it to gradually contract various diseases.
target: Facit ut qui illud tangunt aut intuentur, paulatim varias morbos concipiant.

source: If contact and observation don’t exceed ten seconds, recovery will occur on its own,” Madam Magician briefly explained about the pristine leather.
target: “Si contactus et contemplatio decem secundis non excedunt, sanatio ipsa eveniet,” Domina Magica de corio pristino breviter exponit.

source: Her gaze then shifted to the peculiar candle.
target: Eius aspectus deinde ad pecularem candelam versa est.

source: “This is a corpse wax candle, made from the corpse oils of an Iron-blooded Knight and a Demoness of Despair mixed with other substances.”
target: “Haec est candela cerae cadaveris, confecta ex oleis cadaverum equitis sanguine ferrei et Demonissae Desperationis, cum aliis substantiis mixta.”

source: Corpse wax candle…
target: Candela cerae cadaveris…

source: And from two demigods’ corpse oils…
target: Et ex oleis cadaverum duorum semideorum…

source: Although Lumian had seen much of the world, he still found the candle somewhat eerie and terrifying when he looked at it again.
target: Quamquam Lumian multum orbis terrarum viderat, candelam tamen aliquantulum mira et terrifica invenit cum eam iterum aspexit.

source: “What is its use?” he asked, more concerned with this issue while feeling strangely uneasy.
target: “Quid est eius usus?” rogavit, de hoc magis sollicitus et insuete inquietus.

source: Madam Magician deliberated before responding, “Once lit and used in pacts and Cogitation, it should probably be paired with a ritual, but the specific details and ultimate effect are unclear.
target: Domina Magica antequam responderet deliberavit, “Semel accensa et in pactis et cogitatione adhibita, fortasse cum ritu coniungenda est, sed specifica et effectus ultimus incerti sunt.

source: Hmm, you have the residual aura of the Blood Emperor, maybe you can try it directly without a ritual.”
target: “Hmm, residuam auram Imperatoris Sanguinis habes; fortasse id directe sine ritu conari potes.”

source: Lumian didn’t hesitate.
target: Lumian non dubitavit.

source: “Alright, I’ll try it now.”
target: “Recte, nunc id conabor.”

source: With an Angel and Saint watching over him, if anything went wrong, they could save him.
target: Cum Angelus et Sanctus eum vigilarent, si quid male eveniret, eum servare poterant.

source: Why wait to try it alone when he got back?
target: Cur solus id temptare exspectare, cum rediisset?

source: Neither Magician nor The Hanged Man stopped him.
target: Nec Domina Magica nec vir suspenditus eum prohibuerunt.

source: Lumian took the corpse wax candle from the glass jar and sat cross-legged on the deck.
target: Lumian candelam cerae cadaveris e vitro extraxit et in genu flexis in tabulato consedit.

source: Snap—his fingers produced a blazing white flame, and he immediately lit the black wick of the corpse wax candle.
target: Crispatione digitorum flamma alba ardens oriebatur, et statim atram meinge candelam cerae cadaveris accendit.

source: Then, he closed his eyes, visualized a pattern, and began to Cogitate.
target: Deinde oculos clausit, figuram concipivit, et cogitare incipiebat.

source: In the tranquil state of dispersion, a hint of dark fragrance entered his nostrils, causing his marrow to itch as if it were about to ignite.
target: In tranquillo statu dissipationis, indicium fragrantiæ obscuræ in naribus eius intravit, faciens ut medulla eius prurire videbatur quasi inflammari velletur.

source: Lumian didn’t try to endure this sensation; he simply concentrated on maintaining his cogitative state.
target: Lumian hanc sensationem non tolerare conatus est; sed simpliciter in statu cogitativo permanere contigit.

source: After some time, a dark mist suddenly appeared “before” his eyes.
target: Post aliquod tempus, nebula obscura subito ante oculos eius apparuit.

source: He seemed to be standing in this mist, on the edge of a barely visible street.
target: Videbatur in hac nebula stadi, in margine plateae vix visibilis.

source: Across the street, various not-too-tall buildings appeared as if they were mere shadows.
target: Trans plateam, varia aedificia, non nimis alta, apparuerunt, quasi solum umbrae essent.

source: Ding-ding—a vehicle resembling a steam train came from the other end of the street.
target: Ding-ding — vehiculum, quod tramine vaporario simile videbatur, ex altero extremo plateae venit.

source: It had few segments, just two, with no distinctive chimney but a strangely shaped bracket extending from the top, connecting to something in midair.
target: Paucis segmentis constabat, tantum duobus, sine camini insigni, sed cum angulo insolito ex summo extendente, quod ad aliquid in aere intermedium coniungitur.

source: Wh—Lumian’s memory was instantly triggered.
target: Wh—memoria Lumiani statim excitata est.

source: He had seen a similar scene in Fourth Epoch Trier!
target: Similem scaenam in quarto aetate Trierensi vidit!

source: It heralded the appearance of the second level in that special mirror world.
target: Ea praenuntiavit adventum secundi gradus in illo mundo speculi peculiare.
